svg.title: Prevent Forest Fires: Fire Destroys Timber and Payrolls. British Columbia Forest Service poster, reconstruction
svg.desc: A vector reconstruction drawn from one supplied photograph: a yellow sky, dark conifers, an orange flame field, ivory script and dark capitals, burnt trunks and fallen logs, and the slogan Fire destroys timber and payrolls. Every shape and letter is an editable path, with no embedded image, tracing or external font. Details and colours are interpreted, not a verified archival facsimile.

g.aria-label: Curved flame field and tapered yellow cuts

g.data-label: 04 · Burnt trunks, logs and woodcut marks

g.aria-label: Burnt woodland, fallen timber, splintered stumps and tangled roots
Charred interstitial ground, branch gaps and exposed wood fragments
Fire destroys timber and payrolls! British Columbia Forest Service
